acceptance.description: Implement documented recovery rules and ParseWithDiagnostics results through the shared engine policy hooks.
Test each repair rule, IsComplete/IsWellFormed, bounded diagnostics, callback outcomes and unchanged strict rejection.
Demonstrate the deliverable using only verified dependencies and this task; record actual API/output files and checks at the tested revision. Preserve earlier milestone behavior.

handoff.summary: Predispatch source-only scope assessment: shared recovery hooks are absent. Coordinator grants exact Core policy callsites in XmlParserCore.cs (outside-root,duplicate expanded attributes,ancestor/unmatched close,EOF delivery) with strict/entity/atomic/fatal behavior preserved; Factories.cs only strict Recover=true guards before input/resolver work; ByteDomAdapter.cs only partial modifier. All recovery implementation/accumulation/adapters remain owned Parsing/Recovery and Dom/Recovery.cs partials; no second parser/input rewrite. No implementation or checks claimed; task starts only after conformance verified.
